pwc.title: PwC Switzerland virtual case
pwc.intro: An Excel and Power BI modeling portfolio based on the PwC Switzerland virtual case experience hosted on Forage.
pwc.problem: Call-center operations, customer retention, and workforce questions require different fact grains and clearly defined KPIs. Combining the domains needs shared dimensions without losing those differences.
approach: Organize telephony, retention, and workforce data into a galaxy semantic model.
Use Power Query for transformation and Power Pivot / VertiPaq for analytical modeling.
Define DAX measures and build domain-specific reporting views.
Develop workbook navigation and VBA controls around the reporting experience.
pwc.takeaway: Explore the semantic-model documentation, KPI catalog, Power Query transformations, and VBA modules. The project shows how spreadsheet delivery can be structured and versioned.
pwc.caveat: This is a virtual case experience and portfolio exercise, not employment at PwC or a client engagement.
pwc.stack: Excel · Power Query · Power Pivot · DAX · VBA

customer360.title: Customer 360 banking ETL
customer360.intro: A banking integration capstone combining relational customer data with ATM and credit-card files using Informatica Cloud Data Integration.
customer360.problem: Customer information and transaction records arrive from separate systems. Invalid identifiers and account conditions need explicit routing before creating a consolidated customer view.
approach: Join Oracle banking entities with ATM and credit-card flat-file inputs.
Normalize customer names and enforce a documented exception matrix.
Quarantine non-conforming records with descriptive rejection reasons.
Aggregate customer-level spending and use an upsert delivery pattern.
customer360.takeaway: The mapping and exception documentation make the difference between ingestion and trustworthy integration visible. Review the routing rules and customer-grain output.
customer360.caveat: Academic capstone scenario; no claim of access to real bank customer records or a live banking deployment.
customer360.stack: Informatica IICS · Oracle · CSV · ETL · Data quality

supplychain.title: SMART Supply Chain Insights
supplychain.intro: A supply-chain analysis project connecting Python exploration, Excel modeling, and Power BI reporting.
supplychain.problem: Sales, fulfillment, shipping risk, and suspicious or cancelled orders need to be explored together to understand operational patterns.
approach: Clean and explore the supplied transaction dataset with Python.
Investigate distributions, sales and profit trends, and order-status patterns.
Develop a star-schema model and relationships.
Build Power BI views using DAX and interactive reporting.
supplychain.takeaway: Follow the repository from raw data and EDA to model design and report artifacts. It shows the analytical work behind an operations dashboard.
supplychain.caveat: Repository dataset and analytical findings do not establish realized operational savings or a client engagement.
supplychain.stack: Python · Pandas · Excel · Power BI · DAX

retail.title: B2B retail & churn analytics
retail.intro: A Power BI portfolio exploring retailer lifecycle, delivery performance, sales changes, and category mix in a B2B grocery-distribution scenario.
retail.problem: A sales drop can have several causes. Retention, delivery performance, and commercial mix need separate definitions and a shared reporting model.
approach: Use a star schema to organize the analytical entities and facts.
Build DAX measures for performance and period comparisons.
Explore delivery SLA, cohort retention, activation, and sales-drop decomposition.
Organize the reporting experience into executive, operations, retention, and commercial views.
retail.takeaway: Look at the model, DAX library, and reporting pages to understand how the business questions are decomposed. The repository connects customer lifecycle questions to operational context.
retail.caveat: Shown as a portfolio scenario. Company naming in the repository does not establish a client relationship, and intended business benefits are not measured outcomes.
retail.stack: Power BI · DAX · SQL Server · Star schema

deepclean.title: DeepClean OS
deepclean.intro: A Python data-preparation toolkit with a Streamlit interface for exploring a repeatable cleaning sequence.
deepclean.problem: Data preparation often spreads across ad-hoc notebook cells. A reusable pipeline can make the chosen transformations easier to inspect and repeat.
approach: Organize duplicate removal and temporal feature handling into separate stages.
Provide configurable imputation, outlier treatment, encoding, and scaling.
Expose a Python engine alongside an interactive Streamlit interface.
Document the transformation order and dependencies.
deepclean.takeaway: Explore the modular cleaning implementation and interface. Each transformation should be selected for the dataset and business question; an automated sequence is a tool, not a universal cleaning policy.
deepclean.caveat: A portfolio data-preparation tool. Statistical imputation or outlier treatment may be inappropriate for a particular dataset without domain review.
deepclean.stack: Python · Pandas · NumPy · scikit-learn · SciPy · Streamlit

stockpipeline.title: Stock-price data pipeline
stockpipeline.intro: An automated market-data pipeline connecting Airflow orchestration, Spark processing, object storage, PostgreSQL, and Metabase.
stockpipeline.problem: API availability, raw-data retention, transformation, loading, and delivery need explicit boundaries for a pipeline to be understandable and repeatable.
approach: Check API availability and ingest price data into MinIO raw storage.
Run Spark transformation in a Docker task.
Load the formatted output into a PostgreSQL warehouse.
Connect Metabase reporting and workflow completion notifications.
stockpipeline.takeaway: Read the DAG and architecture documentation to follow dependencies from ingestion to reporting. The project highlights the orchestration around an analytical dataset.
stockpipeline.caveat: A technical portfolio pipeline. The website does not provide live market data, investment advice, or a verified throughput benchmark.
stockpipeline.stack: Airflow · Spark · MinIO · PostgreSQL · Metabase · Docker

insurance.title: National Insurance data warehouse
insurance.intro: An Egyptian Form 5 portfolio scenario covering synthetic data generation, cleaning, orchestration, SQL Server warehousing, and Power BI.
insurance.problem: Insurance-style records involve dates, repeated entities, and validation constraints. A useful warehouse needs consistent processing and explicit analytical views.
approach: Generate synthetic source records for the documented scenario.
Normalize datatypes, handle duplicates, and validate records.
Orchestrate processing and loading with Airflow.
Create SQL Server warehouse structures and analytical views for reporting.
insurance.takeaway: Inspect the generation, cleaning, loading, and SQL-validation modules as one connected workflow. The project puts local domain context into a reproducible learning scenario.
insurance.caveat: All identity and insurance records in the scenario are synthetic. This is not an official government system or access to real insurance records.
insurance.stack: Python · Pandas · Airflow · SQL Server · Power BI · Docker

searchml.title: Applied ML & search intelligence
searchml.intro: A collection of search-intelligence notebooks, feature preparation, model-evaluation code, research writing, and workflow-agent experiments.
searchml.problem: Prioritization models need more than a score: feature definitions, data splits, leakage checks, and evaluation context must be inspectable.
approach: Prepare features and compare a heuristic baseline with a model-based approach.
Explore grouped evaluation splits and temporal-leakage assertions.
Keep notebooks, evaluation outputs, and research documentation together.
Document an n8n-based workflow-agent experiment and its execution flow.
searchml.takeaway: Review the notebooks, evaluation scripts, and research materials to understand the methodology. This portfolio connects my analytics and automation work with a growing focus on machine learning.
searchml.caveat: The website makes no independent claim about model performance or generalization. Evaluation details and the dataset assumptions belong to the linked repository.
searchml.stack: Python · Machine learning · Feature engineering · Evaluation · n8n
